repeat.description: Repeat interval as "<number> <unit>" (e.g. "30 minutes", "1 day", "1 month"), at least 1 minute. Days, weeks and months follow the calendar in the schedule's timezone. If omitted the schedule runs once a day, unless "once" is set

once.description: Run only once; the schedule is disabled after it runs

at.description: An exact moment to run, as an ISO-8601 instant with a Z or UTC offset (e.g. "2026-11-20T09:00:00-05:00"). The schedule runs once at or after it (once, if the app was down then) and is then done. It cannot be combined with repeat, a time window, weekdays or a day of month

after.description: Only run at or after this time of day (HH:mm, 24-hour)

before.description: Only run at or before this time of day (HH:mm, 24-hour)

weekdays.description: Weekdays it may run on, e.g. "mon tue wed thu fri"

dayOfMonth.description: Day of month it may run on (months without that day are skipped)

timezone.description: IANA timezone the schedule is evaluated in; defaults to the server's

maxCostUsd.description: Stop the run and mark it failed when it has spent more than this (USD). Unset: agent.jobs.defaultMaxCostUsd, else no limit

maxApprovalLevel.description: Highest tool approval level the run may approve without asking anyone (see Tool approval levels). Unset: agent.jobs.maxAutoApprovalLevel. Cannot exceed the operator's agent.jobs.approvalCeiling; actions above it are refused
